invariants.description: the effective period is the controlled period, floored: T_eff = max(T + Delta_T, T_min)
the period never falls below its floor: T_eff >= T_min
the phase grows at 1/T_eff: s = the running integral of dt/T_eff (trapezoid, to the solver and output-step accuracy)
the beat fraction stays in [0, 1): mt = s - floor(s)
the protocol drives the clock through its floor and above its resting period: T_eff reaches T_min and exceeds T
invariants.applies: the delta_T_ramp protocol at the run parameters (T 1 s, T_min 0.4 s)

baseline.reason: a phase clock: no measured quantity to compare with. Verified against its exact relations under a Delta_T protocol (T_eff = max(T + Delta_T, T_min), s = integral of dt/T_eff); validated within the controlled system models whose heart-period effector drives it.
